heading: Sunday
text: Mostly sunny. Highs from the upper 50s to near 60 north, in the low to mid 60s south. Calm wind.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly clear south, clouds building over northern New York and the St. Lawrence Valley. Lows in the 30s, nearing 40 around Lake Champlain, a few 20s far south. Light and variable wind.

heading: Monday
text: Increasing clouds cover north with the chance of spotty rain showers, partly cloudy south. Highs from the upper 50s north increasing into the mid-60s south. West winds increasing in the afternoon, between 5 to 10 mph.
